# Docs

- [ORISO Dokumentation](/): Belegte Compliance und Architekturentscheidungen der ORISO-Plattform — aus dem Quellcode abgeleitet, versioniert im Repository ORISO-Docs.
- Recht & Compliance

    - [8 Schutz der Betroffenen — Betroffenenrechte 8.4 bis 8.10](/legal/dsfa/08-betroffenenrechte): Die Betroffenenrechte nach §§ 14 ff. KDG (Art. 12 ff. DSGVO) können bei jedem gemeinsam Verantwortlichen geltend gemacht werden; die interne Zuteilung regelt die Vereinbarung …
    - [10 Ergebnis der Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzung](/legal/dsfa/10-ergebnis): Die Verarbeitungstätigkeit „Bereitstellung und technischer Betrieb der Online-Beratungsplattform" kann in der in Kapitel 6 beschriebenen Ausgestaltung umgesetzt werden — …

- Entscheidungen (ADR)
  - [Architekturentscheidungen (ADR)](/decisions): Plattformweite Architecture Decision Records — 23 Entscheidungen, aus dem Repository ORISO-Docs.
  - [ADR-001: Counselling modalities as toggleable modules](/decisions/adr-001): Status: Proposed — needs a team decision (esp. how registration filters on `consultingtype`) · Datum: 2026-06-23
  - [ADR-002: Silent room membership with an access-control confidentiality curtain (not E2EE)](/decisions/adr-002): Status: Accepted — Frank, 2026-06-25 (team ratification pending) · Datum: 2026-06-25
  - [ADR-003: Department = unique (Agency × Topic) carrying its own imprint + DPP](/decisions/adr-003): Status: Accepted — Frank, 2026-06-25 (team ratification pending) · Datum: 2026-06-25
  - [ADR-004: Keep the custom chat UI; adopt matrix-js-sdk Megolm under it (don't embed Element Web)](/decisions/adr-004): Status: Accepted — 2026-06-26 (grill-with-docs session). June-30 scope and the crypto sequencing are fixed; the SDK-Megolm migration itself is scheduled, not yet built. · Datum: 2026-06-26
  - [ADR-005: Matrix federation deliberately OFF; real DNS server_name via a clean homeserver rebuild](/decisions/adr-005): Status: Accepted — 2026-06-26 (grill-with-docs session). Timing fixed: the clean rebuild runs early July, before any SDK-crypto work and before real carrier onboarding. · Datum: 2026-06-26
  - [ADR-006: `conversation_type` as a persisted modality field, rolled out selector-first](/decisions/adr-006): Status: Accepted — 2026-06-28 (grill-with-docs session). Decision made; implementation scheduled. · Datum: 2026-06-28
  - [ADR-007: Live-chat liveness — the indicator reads backend Availability, never mirrors or infers it](/decisions/adr-007): Status: Accepted — 2026-06-28 (grill-with-docs session). Root causes verified; fix scheduled. · Datum: 2026-06-28
  - [ADR-008: Supervision — keep per-session agency-scoped reach; move side-channels out of the client's room](/decisions/adr-008): Status: Proposed — 2026-06-28 (grill-with-docs session); U25 cohort + go-live date resolved 2026-06-30 (minors are in U25 scope; go-live 2026-10-01, no 30.06 launch). The separate-room side-channel exclusion is therefore a confirmed pre-go-live blocker (with runway). Still pending: the data-protection officer's exact disclosure wording and the add-supervisor authority/consent details. · Datum: 2026-06-28
  - [ADR-009: Global Topic/Category ownership and AI-assisted translation infrastructure](/decisions/adr-009): Status: Accepted — Frank, 2026-07-01 (grill-with-docs session). Design decided now ("set the points"); implementation deliberately deferred, see Rollout below. · Datum: 2026-07-01
